source.rule: Narrative facts, names, aliases, locations and movements are extracted only from the eight Book I chapter files. External sources are used only for contextual micro-wiki summaries and modern geographic identification.

title: Earth

quality_rules.explicit: Directly stated or unambiguously shown in the chapter text.
quality_rules.strong_inference: Strongly implied by the chapter text but not stated as a completed fact.
quality_rules.weak_inference: Plausible but not sufficiently certain for reader-facing map data.
quality_rules.spoiler_boundary: No later-book information is used to resolve a Book I ambiguity.
quality_rules.physical_presence: A character is physically present only when the source places them on-page in the scene; a letter, report, signature or discussion does not count as physical presence.
quality_rules.reported_position: A reported location may be stored for continuity but must not create a physical marker unless the narrative establishes presence.

chapter_audit.1: Sekigahara → Mount Ibuki → intended direction of Tarui → Oko/Akemi house. Tarui is not an arrival.
chapter_audit.2: Takezo and Matahachi remain at the refuge until the final night. The source explicitly ends with Oko, Akemi and Matahachi gone and Takezo discovering the empty house.
chapter_audit.3: Otsu/Takuan move Shippoji → Aida River → Ogin House → festival at Shippoji. Matahachi, Akemi and Oko are discussed or absent but not physically present.
chapter_audit.4: Ogin is physically arrested at Ogin House and reported held at Hinagura. Otsu witnesses the arrest and escapes to Shippoji. Takezo remains in the Sanumo mountains.
chapter_audit.5: Otsu/Takuan travel to Itadori Pasture and capture Takezo. Matahachi/Oko are known only through letters; Ogin is discussed as imprisoned, not physically present. Lord Ikeda appears only through the signature on the search notices.
chapter_audit.6: Takezo is at the old cryptomeria at Shippoji; Takuan, Otsu and Osugi are physically present around the punishment scene. Aoki Tanzaemon is not present or named in this chapter.
chapter_audit.7: Takezo and Otsu escape together, separate at Nakayama Pass, Otsu reaches Mikazuki and later disappears into a ravine. Osugi and Gonroku pursue her. Takezo reaches Hinagura, learns Ogin was transferred, and heads for Himeji.
chapter_audit.8: Takezo reaches Himeji, enters Himeji Castle, spends about three years confined, is released and renamed Miyamoto Musashi. Otsu is subsequently revealed to have waited three years at Hanada Bridge. Osugi/Gonroku and Aoki are only reported, not physically present.

adjacent_audit.1-2: Takezo/Matahachi remain together at Oko's refuge until the final night of chapter 2; the actual departing group is Oko + Akemi + Matahachi, while Takezo remains.
adjacent_audit.2-3: Chapter 3 does not show the departing group again. Their last known location is the refuge, while their current position is unknown.
adjacent_audit.3-4: Takezo flees the festival and is pursued in chapter 4; Otsu returns to Shippoji after Ogin's arrest; Ogin's state changes to prisoner at Hinagura.
adjacent_audit.4-5: Takezo remains in the mountains until he follows Otsu/Takuan to Itadori. Ogin remains imprisoned; Matahachi remains absent and is later confirmed alive by letter.
adjacent_audit.5-6: Takezo's capture at Itadori is followed immediately by his return to Shippoji and restraint at the cryptomeria.
adjacent_audit.6-7: Takezo remains bound until Otsu frees him; they then travel together to Nakayama Pass and separate.
adjacent_audit.7-8: Otsu's post-ravine recovery is intentionally unresolved in chapter 7 and established in chapter 8 as a three-year wait at Hanada Bridge. Takezo's Himeji destination becomes confirmed at the start of chapter 8.

critical_corrections: Chapter 2 departure is a group departure: Oko, Akemi and Matahachi leave the refuge together.
Chapter 3 contains no physical appearance of Akemi; she remains only a prior-state/absent character.
Chapter 4 Otsu is not captured; she witnesses Ogin's arrest and escapes to Shippoji.
Chapter 4 Ogin's final physical state is Hinagura, not Ogin House.
Chapter 5 Lord Ikeda is mentioned through his signature, not physically present.
Chapter 6 Aoki Tanzaemon is not present and should not receive a Chapter 6 location.
Chapter 7 Otsu does not reach Hanada Bridge within the chapter; that arrival/wait is established retrospectively in Chapter 8.
Chapter 8 Musashi's end state is departure from Himeji, not continued imprisonment; Takuan also departs after the release.
Chapter 8 Osugi, Gonroku and Aoki are reported rather than physically located at Himeji.

identity_checkpoint.evidence: Ikeda Terumasa and Takuan explicitly establish the new name during Takezo's release from confinement.
identity_checkpoint.spoiler_rule: The internal character ID remains musashi; only the reader-facing display name changes at the narrative point where the new name is established.
